protocol_content.title: Non-fasting versus fasting before percutaneous cardiac procedures
protocol_content.research_question: Among adults undergoing percutaneous cardiac or cardiac device procedures, compare a non-fasting protocol with conventional fasting for patient-reported comfort and the safety outcomes defined by the Review.
protocol_content.review_criteria: Include randomized controlled trials comparing non-fasting with fasting before percutaneous cardiac or cardiac device procedures. Collect the Review-defined satisfaction, symptom and safety outcomes using participant counts for binary outcomes or reported means, standard deviations and group sizes for continuous outcomes.

result_targets.population: Adults undergoing elective or semiurgent percutaneous cardiac or cardiac device procedures in randomized controlled trials.
result_targets.outcome_definition: Trial-reported composite patient satisfaction or well-being score.
result_targets.timepoint: Preprocedural or periprocedural assessment specified by each trial.
result_targets.analysis_population: Participants analyzed in the randomized groups for the selected outcome.
result_targets.selection_rule: Use the randomized comparison and extract reported participant counts for binary outcomes or final means, standard deviations, and outcome-specific group sizes for continuous outcomes.
